author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for ReVamp, a tower-defense roguelike game developed by Digital Sun. Players will head straight into the heat of battle as Dracula to defend the throne. Dish out brutal melee attacks, master new abilities, and secure the castle at all costs. ReVamp is launching on March 25, 2027 for PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: ReVamp - Official Release Date Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Hela: of Mice & Magic, an open-world adventure game developed by Windup. Players will embark on a grand adventure in the Swedish wilderness to solve puzzles and take in the beauty of nature. 

Hela: of Mice & Magic is launching on December 1 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC).
title: Hela: of Mice & Magic - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Prospice: Anomalous Logistics, an atmospheric driving exploration game developed by Code Wakers. Players will explore an uncharted island warped by the remains of decaying gods, exploring its mysteries with your trusty off-road truck. Plot routes through treacherous terrain, keep remote outposts supplied, and dare to leave safety and your truck behind to uncover occult artifacts and forgotten truths. Prospice: Anomalous Logistics is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Outward 2, a survival action-adventure RPG developed by Nine Dots Studio. Players will endure one brutal challenge after another to explore the world, seek out enemies, and survive the adventures that await. Outward 2 is launching into Early Access on February 8th, 2027 for PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG).
title: Outward 2 - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Militsioner, a first-person atmospheric stealth action game developed by Tallboys. Players will make careful moves while being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this surreal immersive sim. Militsioner is coming soon to Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Militsioner - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Decode intercepted messages aboard a secret military submarine in this narrative cryptography thriller, where every decision can carry deadly consequences. Check out the latest False Echo trailer for this upcoming game developed and published by Retromagine. False Echo will be available on PC in spring 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: False Echo - Official Demo Launch & Release Window Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Machinarium 2, a hand-drawn 2D adventure game developed by Amanita Design. Players will witness the tale of Josef and Berta as they discover a hidden valley settled by two peculiar robot tribes slowly running short of power. This time you guide both heroes, switching between them freely to crack puzzles neither could solve alone. The whole game is hand-drawn and expressively animated, giving a world of rusted machines something unexpectedly human. Tomáš Dvořák aka Floex returns to compose the score. Machinarium 2 is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Machinarium 2 - Official Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Playtest Launch Trailer for Living Hell, a first-person co-op horror shooter developed by Joe Fender. Players will navigate through Pelican City, a region that has a collapsed ozone layer thats exposed the city to devastating solar radiation, triggering widespread and terrifying mutations. Survive the city in Living Hell, coming soon to PC (Steam) with a playtest available now on Steam.
title: Living Hell - Official Playtest Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
This December, Escape the Backrooms drops its biggest content update yet: You are invited to the After Party, a brand-new liminal space to survive with up to three friends, packed with fresh threats, puzzles and secrets. Check out the latest Escape the Backrooms trailer to see what's coming with the update in October, which brings new skins. The new trailer also gives a peek at the After Party update coming in December. 

Escape the Backrooms is available now on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2.
title: Escape the Backrooms - Official After Party Update Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: From the developers of "Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis" comes their latest game, Drunken Goddess Reflux. Shot glass Russian roulette against Femme Soule, a demon who loves you enough to kill you. Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon till she spills it all. Survive the night, and savor seven flavors of ruin! Drunken Goddess Reflux will be available on PC on December 8, 2026. A demo is out on Steam beginning October 19, 2026.
title: Drunken Goddess Reflux - Official Demo & Release Date Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Dave the Diver x Subnautica 2 trailer for this upcoming crossover between the RPG adventure game and the underwater survival adventure game. Dave takes his harpoon far from the Blue Hole and into an alien ocean where the locals aren't quite so welcoming. New depths, new creatures, and plenty Dave has never run into before.

Dave the Diver is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Nintendo Switch. The Dave the Diver x Subnautica 2 DLC will be available in early 2027.
title: Dave the Diver x Subnautica 2 - Official DLC Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Dandelion Void's first public demo is out now! Take your first steps through the jungle-choked halls of the doomed generation ship Pergola. Establish a refuge and forage resources from the remains of your dead ancestors, and try to survive the horrors that doomed them. From the creator of the wildly popular 'Save Our Station' Project Zomboid mod. 

Dandelion Void launches into Early Access on Steam in 2027.
title: Dandelion Void - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: You thought you’d escaped Hell. Think again. Check out the Chained Together trailer for this 1–4 player co-op platformer game for a peek at the new map coming this November. Chained Together is available on Steam.
title: Chained Together - Official New Map Reveal Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture is a raunchy new take on a cozy farming genre – if those crops were akin to Jay and Silent Bob’s specific cultural tastes. The game is a love letter to filmmaker Kevin Smith’s beloved cult classic characters – within the digital realm. Players will build, cultivate and expand their operation, interact with familiar faces, and experience an original story featuring Kevin Smith's iconic characters.

Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture is currently heading toward its playtesting phase of production, with an expected release in late Spring 2027 on Steam/PC. A console release is also slated for 2027.
title: Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture - Official Trailer | NYCC 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
From the creators of Breathedge, this 1–4 player co-op PvE shooter drops you into a brutal, ever-changing world where danger can take any shape. Face supernatural creatures known as the Awakened, forge Blood Pacts to wield their abilities, explore hostile canyons aboard colossal Crawlers, build up your settlement, and make hard calls to keep your crew alive. 

Canyons will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S in November 2027.
title: Canyons - Release Window Announcement Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: The ultimate potato survivor is back with its new DLC, with bigger and badder enemies. Check out the latest Brotato: Primal Dread trailer for this upcoming DLC for the top-down arena-shooter roguelite game. Brotato: Primal Dread will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG on November 2, 2026. It is coming early 2027 on consoles and mobile.
title: Brotato - Official Primal Dread DLC Release Date Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
It’s time to head back to Astral Ascent for a new collaboration with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33! Both the main cast and iconic bosses like Mimes and Pétank are joining the platformer roguelite. This free update includes 6 new summons, 3 bosses, 2 music tracks and 3 different rooms. And yes, you can hug Esquie... of course you can!

The Astral Ascent x Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - For Those Who Come After update is now available for free on Steam, Humble, Epic Games Store, GOG, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch.
title: Astral Ascent x Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Official Update Trailer | Triple-i Initiative 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Among Us Story: On Guard trailer for this upcoming new standalone, detective narrative game from the creators of Among Us. In Among Us Story: On Guard, prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you. Among Us Story: On Guard will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and mobile on February 17, 2027.
title: Among Us Story: On Guard - Official Release Date Trailer | Triple-i Initiative Fall Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Demo Launch Trailer for Pastdark, a co-op horror extraction game. Players will interact with the notion of Madness itself, which makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you. Pastdark is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Pastdark - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Outcast Tales, a tactical roguelite RPG. Players will assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions, and choose your own adventures. Outcast Tales is launching on October 26 for PC (Steam).
title: Outcast Tales - Official Release Date Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Release Date Trailer for The Witch's Bakery, a 2D adventure RPG. Players will live out the magical life as a witch-baker in Paris. Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants. The Witch's Bakery is launching on October 14 for PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: The Witch's Bakery - Official Release Date Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a Game Trailer for Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up, an alchemy puzzle organization game developed by Skill Issue Studios. Players will clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique recipes and place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace. Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up is coming to PC (Steam).
title: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up - Official Game Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Station 58 announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy puzzle adventure game. Piece together a national park scattered across the sky in Station 58. Play solo or couch co-op as Starla and Shorty, a park ranger and her giant robot friend. Solve alien cube puzzles, rearrange lost parklands, and uncover what fractured the park. Station 58 will be available on PC. You can join the playtest on Steam if you're interested.
title: Station 58 - Official Announce Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode? Watch the latest Bombanana! trailer to see new content added to the PC version of the party game. Bombanana! Is available now on PC (Steam), the App Store, and Google Play.
title: Bombanana! - Official Update Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a Demo Release Date Trailer for Expendabots, a co-op horror-extraction game. Players will explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons as mere expendable robots. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost. Expendabots is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on October 10 on Steam.
title: Expendabots - Official Demo Release Date Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Ballistic.exe is a despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Dozens of weapons, 200+ cartridges, 1000+ attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural. Check out the Ballistic.exe trailer ahead of its launch on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Ballistic.exe - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Glasshouse, a turn-based feudalpunk CRPG. Players will find themselves in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you. Glasshouse is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Glasshouse - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it? Get a fresh look at gameplay from Kick in this new trailer for the upcoming sports game. Kick will be available on PC on November 3, 2026.
title: Kick - Official Release Date Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for The Great Wife's Guide, a 2D narrative-driven adventure game. Players will  take on the role of Dolores, a devoted housewife pushed to her breaking point by a toxic marriage and the suffocating pressure of maintaining a flawless suburban life. Across short, focused puzzle levels, you will explore retro cartoon dollhouse environments, arrange carefully calculated acts of sabotage, and uncover the secrets concealed behind the walls of the perfect family home. The Great Wife's Guide is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching in 2027.
title: The Great Wife's Guide - Official Reveal Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares? Tenebris Somnia will be available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and GOG) on October 16, 2026.
title: Tenebris Somnia - Official Gameplay Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison. Watch the latest Emberville trailer for this upcoming action RPG to see gameplay and more. Emberville will be available in Early Access on PC on October 27, 2026. A demo will be available during Steam Next Fest from October 19 to October 26, 2026.
title: Emberville - Official Demo Announcement Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories. Watch the Penguin Colony launch trailer for this upcoming retro Lovecraftian walking simulator. Penguin Colony will be available on PC on October 16, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Penguin Colony - Official Launch Trailer | Convergence Games Showcase October 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the DMZ Story Missions Trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the next installment in the first-person shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Players will explore narrative-driven missions across DMZ to secure intel, overcome challenges, and explore a sprawling, multi-part storyline within the extraction mode. DMZ Story Missions are part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Story Missions Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Qingzhou Announcement Trailer for Where Winds Meet, the hit open-world action RPG developed by Everstone Studio. Players will traverse a whole new region with the coastal-mountain realm of Qingzhou, packed with stories to be told and adventures to embark on. Qingzhou is launching on October 15 to Where Winds Meet on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Where Winds Meet - Official Qingzhou Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest trailer for Hell is Us to see what to expect from the new update, which brings 10 new hollow walkers to the action-adventure game. The new trailer also announces that Hell is Us is now on Nintendo Switch 2. The new update is out now. Hell is Us is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
title: Hell is Us - Official Nintendo Switch 2 & Major Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Halloween Horror Ghastly Getaway Gameplay for Killing Floor 3, the hit first-person action shooter developed by Tripwire Interactive. Players can partake in the frights and mayhem of the season with gameplay from the Halloween Horror Ghastly Getaway update. The Halloween Horror Ghastly Getaway update for Killing Floor 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Killing Floor 3 - Official Halloween Horror Ghastly Getaway Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description:
Spooky season has arrived once again in Killing Floor 3 with the new in-game event: Halloween Horrors: Ghastly Getaway. Check out the latest Killing Floor 3 trailer to see what to expect from this new event, which brings the Halloween season to 2091, starting with a completely redecorated player Stronghold to set the spooky tone. The event also features new models for all base Zeds and the Moorcroft boss, inspired by classic horror movies, with both seasonal visual updates running through November 5, 2026.

The update also adds new permanent content, including the Haunted Hotel map, new single-weapon Gunslinger primary weapons, new Supply Pass and store cosmetics, and more.

Killing Floor 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. The Halloween Horrors: Ghastly Getaway event is now live.
title: Killing Floor 3 - Halloween Horrors: Ghastly Getaway Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Ken Ryuguji from Tokyo Revengers, appearing as a guest fighter for the first time in Fatal Fury City of the Wolves. Ryuguji is a brawler, prefering to get in his opponents face and overwhelm them with punches and kicks. While seemingly undisclipined, what Ryuguji lacks in form, he makes up for in power, able to knock down any foe that gets in his way. Get into the fight when Ken Ryuguji arrives in South Town on October 22nd. 
Fatal Fury City of the Wolves is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Ken Ryuguji Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this teaser for an upcoming Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Collab with Tekken 8. While it is yet to be officially confirmed, it certainly seems that Reina Mishima will be taking a trip to South Town. The daughter of Heihachi Mishima, Reina uses a custom form of Mishima-Ryu Karate, and will no doubt come to South Town with her signature Mishima-style techniques, ready for the next battle. 
Fatal Fury City of the Wolves is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official TEKKEN 8 Collab Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Manjiro Sano from Tokyo Revengers, appearing as a guest fighter for the first time in Fatal Fury City of the Wolves. Sano uses brutal hard hitting strikes to destroy the opposition, prefering a no-frills approach to combat, he destroys any target that dares get in his way. You can crush your enemies when Manjiro Sano arrives in South Town on October 22nd! 
Fatal Fury City of the Wolves is out now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Manjiro Sano Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom DLC 2 Release Date Trailer for Marvel Cosmic Invasion, the hit beat 'em up action game developed by DotEmu. Players can soon embody the transparent Invisible Woman and the powerful Doctor Doom in chaotic brawls across the galaxy with the upcoming DLC. Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom are launching into Marvel Cosmic Invasion for DLC 2 on November 10 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion - Official Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom DLC 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: An omen of what's to come. Watch the latest trailer for Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, an upcoming expansion to the open-world action RPG. The new trailer, narrated by Ron Perlman, dives into the world and story of Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen. Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on October 9, 2026.
title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Official Trailer (feat. Ron Perlman)

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Accolades Trailer for Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition, the definitive edition of the hit third-person action open-world adventure game developed by Sucker Punch. Players can access the base game alongside Echoes of Sekigahara, a new story expansion, and Most Wanted, a combat survival mode with the Complete Edition. Become a Ghost in Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Warning: Trailer contains flashing lights. 

Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival is available now on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the brutal launch trailer for Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival for another look at this survival-horror action game.

In Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival, unlock the cursed powers of the Genesis Configuration on a damned quest to save your girlfriend from the depths of the underworld while fending off the dark forces who wish to unleash Hell on Earth.

Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival features the return of Doug Bradley as the voice of Pinhead, the role he first carved into our collective nightmares nearly 40 years ago. Do you have the courage to survive against the demonic Cenobites and the legions of fanatical cultists who worship them? Or will your suffering be legendary, even in Hell…
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Official Launch Trailer (Warning: Flashing Lights)

description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Kingdom Hearts Collection , a collection of the hit action RPGs developed by Square Enix. Players can access KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) to learn more about the adventures of Sora, Donald, and Goofy. Kingdom Hearts Collection is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC).
title: Kingdom Hearts Collection [I ~ III] - Official Launch Trailer
